title: MOSAIC-G11 — Multi-plane Operation-Specific Aligned Identity Capsule
summary: G11 preserves COVE's operation-specific causal slice and adds multi-axis identity plus a logically unified, physically polyglot data/query fabric. Consequential operations distinguish semantic equality, exact provenance instance, basis/epoch, selector/query-plan and concrete reader-view identity. UnifiedDB initially unifies semantic/query/transaction contracts, not all physical storage. Derived graph/vector/FTS/activation views carry derivation/epoch/selection receipts; MRSC remains the reader/cognition lowering after trusted semantics.
